notes: Quiet Sunday news day; all direct WebFetch attempts would have hit EGRESS_BLOCKED as in prior runs, so every entry below is sourced from search results quoting/citing the organisation's own domain (no failedSources logged since no genuine 403/404/timeout was hit). Also did not file Microsoft's September 8, 2026 Patch Tuesday, for the same reason the Aug 29 run skipped it: the existing generically-titled 'Microsoft Patch Tuesday' entry is dated 2026-10-13, and apply-findings' EVENT_DRIFT_DAYS tolerance would silently overwrite that October date rather than add September as its own row - this is a known dedup gap worth fixing in apply-findings/id.ts for recurring monthly events. Two solid forward-dated additions this run: containerd 1.7's end-of-life (confirmed from containerd's own GitHub RELEASES.md, cited via search) and KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027's dates (confirmed via events.linuxfoundation.org, not previously on file despite MWC Barcelona 2027 and GTC 2027 already being there for the same month).
